correctness.rationale: The quadratic restriction on the four-dimensional span is \(2ac+2B(u,v)bd\), so smoothness is equivalent to \(B(u,v)\ne0\) and the orthogonal case factors into two planes. The displayed orbit families are isotropic for every parameter and join the forced inner line \(\mathbf P\langle u,v\rangle\). Criticality two forces every reducible cycle to have the same intermediate fixed line, giving uniqueness off the diagonal. Corollary 2.7 and Theorem 3.12 of arXiv:2503.19663v1 supply membership in the Chow quotient and irreducibility of the boundary divisor.
